newsitem.title: USA: Dawson completes Pride Pete buy.
newsitem.headline: Dawson completes Pride Pete buy.

text.p: Dawson Production Services Inc said Thursday it has completed the previously announced purchase of the domestic onshore well servicing operations of Pride Petroleum Services Inc for $135.9 million in cash.
The financing of the acquisition was accomplished through the issuance of debt and equity, Dawson said.
In making this acquisition, Dawson has become the largest provider of well servicing rigs in Texas and the second largest provider in the U.S.

Pride's domestic land-based fleets consists of 407 workover rigs that operate from 21 yards concentrated primarily in the Texas and Louisiana Gulf Coasts, the Permian Basin areas of West Texas and New Mexico, and California.
